messages.author: 53626e29c26886b6
messages.subject: Double scroll bar (shinyapps now in iframes to blame)?
parts:
Take a look at any apps hosted on shinyapps eg ones in the gallery.

They now have a double scroll bar if the content is long eg: http://shiny.rstudio.com/gallery/reactivity.html. Should it be that iframe scrollable should be set to "NO"?

I guess the switch has been made to enable showing the app on custom domains.

Can you please fix this?

Thanks!
